definitions.fresh_confluence: a buy or rebuy marker in site/signals/<T>.json (transition events)
definitions.knowability: marker date is the 3D bucket OPEN label; knowability = that bucket's LAST session (derived -- signal_date does not exist on this base, it ships in unmerged PR #4987)
definitions.reaction_pct: close(reaction session)/close(prior session)-1, reaction session derived from the announcement window
definitions.excess: name return minus SPY return over the same session span, in pp
definitions.cohort_a: buy/rebuy knowable in [T-5, T-1] sessions before report T
definitions.cohort_b: buy/rebuy with NO report within +/-10 sessions (entry control)
definitions.cohort_c: report date with NO pre-report confluence (base rate)
